description: Labeled synthetic PII corpus for the Task 4.1 recall gate. Every case is invented call-transcript-like text; entities list the PII values that must be redacted OR the call held. No real customer data. Bare-location and bare-organization cases moved to precision.json under the ADR 0006 entity-type policy (they are asserted NOT redacted there); org cases here survive only as deny-list entities.
